author: mrcharlesky
title: Hiring Graphic Artist and Video Editor
content: Hiring: 🎨 GRAPHIC ARTIST AND 📸 VIDEO EDITOR! Job Title: Graphic Artist (Freelance) The Role: You will work closely with our social media manager. We are not only looking for someone with a sharp eye for design but also someone meticulous with text placement (such as CTA) and image compositions that convert viewers into followers, players, wishlisters, etc. Moreover, we need someone who is proactive with design suggestions and reflects brand elements surrounding Philippine culture & tradition incorporated into our games. Key Responsibilities: - Create game content poster layouts and graphic images for social media use. Use digital illustration, photo editing software, and layout software to create designs. - Collaborate with the social media team and production team to develop creative solutions. -Follow brand guidelines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and revision feedback efficiently. Job Title: Video Editor (Freelance) ... SEND YOUR CV & PORTFOLIO to: support@dalluyonstudio.com

author: craftspace_
title: Early Career Shadow Artist Opportunity
content: EARLY CAREER ARTIST OPPORTUNITY Are you an early career artist or creative wanting to gain some experience in community participation? We are recruiting a shadow artist to support the delivery of creative textile workshops in community venues across Birmingham as part of our 40 Objects for 40 Years touring exhibition. Fee: £1157.80 for 2 planning/preparation dates and 5 half day workshops. When: Workshops take place January - April 2027. More info: Click on the information sheet on the weblink in our bio for more details about the role. How to apply: send a 150 word expression of interest to info@craftspace.co.uk. Alternatively, you can call, text, voicenote or video your expression of interest to 07483 656865 via WhatsApp. Apply by: Sunday 6th December 2026 For more information on the application process visit our website https://craftspace.co.uk/shadow-artist/ or via the link in our bio.
